column1: # mapping_set_description: fraternal ceremony types placed under the membership gathering-type hub.

column8: The meal with toasts that follows a lodge meeting; a kind of formal dinner, not of ceremony.
A feast in honour of the order's patron; fraternalc:CeremonyTypes counts it as a kind of ceremony.
No ritual is worked, so it is a kind of meeting and not of mbrc:ceremony.
The assembly of the members, which decides the affairs of the Verbindung.
A gathering with communal singing and drinking, governed by fixed rules of conduct.
A ceremonial form of the Kneipe, more formal than a social evening.
The yearly celebration of the foundation.
A regulated fencing bout under fixed rules; nobody wins or loses it, so only a loose kind of contest.
